scope: Analytical current-covariance diagnostic on the unchanged graph under independent Poisson source groups with a coherent small fractional rate modulation. Exact synaptic current-square kernels on both sides isolate allocation error. This does not alter the response fit, does not recover native cell correlations, and authorizes no new network run or model promotion.
